736:t_1:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「...I can't believe it... $$サクリファイ$$, defeated by Earthlings...」

736:t_1:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Forgive me, $$ドクトリン$$... By the time I arrived, it was already over.」

736:t_1:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But why!? $$御使い$$s are eternal beings!」

736:t_1:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Most likely it's because $$サクリファイ$$ rejected her own eternity. I can't think of any other explanation.」

736:t_1:8.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「She denied her own existence as an $$御使い$$, then... Swallowed by the emotion called sorrow, she was bound to do it.」

736:t_1:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Even so, it's fortunate that we recovered four $$スフィア$$s from $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」

736:t_1:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Though he himself slipped away from us...」

736:t_1:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Serves him right, that guy. We know where every $$スフィア$$ is now, so he's useless to us anyway.」

736:t_1:12.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Leave him be. All that remains is to take back the other four $$スフィア$$s the Earthlings hold.」

736:t_1:13.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Without the $$いがみ合う双子$$ at its core, the rebirth of $$至高神ソル$$ cannot be achieved.」

736:t_1:14.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Though now that a way to stop the universe's great collapse has been established, there is no longer any need to hurry the rebirth ritual.」

736:t_1:15.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「And the key to that... is the Earthlings, right?」

736:t_1:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「They are heading this way.」

736:t_1:17.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Perfect timing. With this we can stop the universe's great collapse too.」

736:t_1:18.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We have already begun annihilating the wicked species in every universe. We will be the ones to finish the job.」

736:t_1:19.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then I will take on the Earthlings... I'll deal with $c myself.」

736:t_1:20.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I took an interest in them, after all. I'd like them to make up for even a ten-thousandth of the disappointment I have tasted.」

736:t_1:21.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「In that case, you are permitted to use the eight $$スフィア$$s. We will proceed with adjusting $$プロディキウム$$.」

736:t_1:22.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「After we gather all twelve $$スフィア$$s, we will perform the rebirth ritual to save the universe more reliably.」

736:t_1:23.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I leave that part to you both, $$ドクトリン$$.」

736:t_1:24.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
(Now then, $c... Show me your final struggle.)

736:t_1:31.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The fighting that has gone on since the $$多元戦争$$... All of it is about to end...」

736:t_1:32.en:
$$シン$$
「$$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$ in the $$多元戦争$$... $$次元将$$ $$ガイオウ$$ in the $$破界事変$$ and $$再世戦争$$... All those battles led back to the $$御使い$$s.」

736:t_1:33.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I never imagined it would grow into something that drew in every parallel world.」

736:t_1:34.en:
$$シン$$
「...It's not something to say at a time like this, but...」

736:t_1:37.en:
$$シン$$
「Because I got to meet you and everyone else.」

736:t_1:39.en:
$$アスラン$$
「The reason we can laugh together like this now is all the different experiences we had in the multiverse.」

736:t_1:40.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「The fact that I'm here like this is the same, isn't it.」

736:t_1:41.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「If the $$大時空震動$$ hadn't happened, I might never have ended up going out with $$シン$$.」

736:t_1:45.en:
$$シン$$
「$$カミーユ$$ and $$キラ$$ too!」

736:t_1:46.en:
$$アスラン$$
「But going beyond all those 'what ifs', here we are now, together.」

736:t_1:47.en:
$$ファ$$
「Through meetings and partings, over and over, we are now of one heart.」

736:t_1:48.en:
$$フォウ$$
「There was a lot of sadness, but there was even more happiness.」

736:t_1:49.en:
$$カツ$$
「To keep all that from ending, we absolutely have to win the next battle.」

736:t_1:50.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If we lose, everything ends... It won't be just us dying. Everything in the world... in the universe will vanish.」

736:t_1:51.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let's fight. Carrying the feelings and strength of all life.」

736:t_1:53.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「If we defeat the $$御使い$$s, will it all be over...?」

736:t_1:54.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Even if we clear those guys out, if we can't stop the universe's great collapse, it's curtains for us anyway.」

736:t_1:55.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So once we solve both of those, peace finally comes, huh.」

736:t_1:56.en:
$$マリー$$
「But even if that day comes...」

736:t_1:57.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Someone will show up again someday to break that peace.」

736:t_1:58.en:
$$カトル$$
「But I'm sure someone will appear to fight them, too.」

736:t_1:59.en:
$$トロワ$$
「If there's no one, then we can do it ourselves.」

736:t_1:60.en:
$$五飛$$
「This life... I dedicated it long ago to become a foundation of peace.」

736:t_1:61.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Yeah! That's a soldier's duty too!」

736:t_1:62.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Exactly. It's also the path I found.」

736:t_1:63.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Fighting the enemies who threaten peace is our role...」

736:t_1:64.en:
$$ノイン$$
「And the peace we win will be protected by $$リリーナ$$ and the others.」

736:t_1:65.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That is why we must win. Against the $$御使い$$s, and against the universe's great collapse.」

736:t_1:67.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$ヒイロ$$... What will you do when the fighting is over?」

736:t_1:70.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What do you intend to do?」

736:t_1:71.en:
$$刹那$$
「If I can make it through this battle...」

736:t_1:72.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm thinking of going to the home planet of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

736:t_1:74.en:
$$刹那$$
「The thing we gained in this battle... I want to confirm once more what it means to understand each other... The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are where I'll start.」

736:t_1:75.en:
$$刹那$$
「And if we really have grasped the truth of the universe, I want to create something new with it.」

736:t_1:76.en:
$$刹那$$
「Even if it takes years... or decades.」

736:t_1:78.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I want to know what new thing you create, too.」

736:t_1:80.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「If we defeat the $$御使い$$s, will it all be over...?」

736:t_1:81.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Even if we clear those guys out, if we can't stop the universe's great collapse, it's curtains for us anyway.」

736:t_1:82.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So once we solve both of those, peace finally comes, huh.」

736:t_1:83.en:
$$マリー$$
「But even if that day comes...」

736:t_1:84.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Someone will show up again someday to break that peace.」

736:t_1:85.en:
$$カトル$$
「But I'm sure someone will appear to fight them, too.」
